notes: Canonical ClientFlow 1.3.31 repairs the physically observed pre-activation reboot sequencing defect from 1.3.30/1231. After durable pending_manual_activation, 02 Aktiver ClientFlow now prepares the preactivation GUI and first-activation waiter, queues the controlled operator-confirmed reboot, and returns without attempting active-release-only kiosk lockdown in the same boot. Lockdown and final handoff remain owned by the post-reboot canonical activation path. Embedded runtime Python deliberately remains 3.13.14.

This selector authority is intentionally fresh-install-only. The immutable approved bundle advertises in_place_update as a technical bundle capability, but no authentic older physical ClientFlow baseline has proven that path for 1.3.31. Therefore update_allowed is false and in_place_update is absent from catalog install_modes. Do not infer update compatibility from bundle capabilities.

Promoted to fresh-install selection only after exact source aa9a57caa7a08fed17baaa0395a6638173f0e265 had green canonical CI, source-qualified runtime-input transport #16 produced sequence-1232 inputs at size 222248960 and SHA-256 14c5fee3193b8a8c93559643afa5bf96de910ca64233e483628aafee643021fb, release-build #37 / run 37362499461 produced byte-identical candidates, approval #19 approved candidate 5eaf9e789663e76a5c65c9c4e55a84394c07dfd6b4f2395d0a19ef1effdbd9b5 with installer 4500e3f699298ed7bad06be4070942339c1a04a233e68f9c6ae1cdf4dadf0179, and the exact 224174080-byte approved bundle was transported, immutably published and independently re-read at SHA-256 289489ce65501e8573d1406405cfd68b4e044ff8d0fc13b5f82d9a0ab72eb65f before this selector change. Final clean Ubuntu 26.04 fresh-install physical acceptance remains the immediate post-deployment gate.
